# `mlang-format` manual

```roff
.TH MLANG-FORMAT 1 "May 2026" "MLang" "User Commands"
.SH NAME
mlang-format \- source formatter for MLang code
.SH SYNOPSIS
.B mlang-format
[\fB\-i\fR|\fB\-\-in\-place\fR]
[\fB\-\-style\fR file]
[\fB\-\-root\fR \fIDIR\fR]
[\fB\-\-assume\-filename\fR \fIPATH\fR]
[\fIPATH\fR]
.SH DESCRIPTION
.B mlang-format
formats MLang source code. When a path is given it reads that file, formats
it, and writes the result to standard output unless in-place rewriting is
requested. Without a path it reads from standard input and writes the formatted
result to standard output.
.PP
Configuration is discovered from a
.I .mlang-format
file. The current implementation supports a
.B file
style mode and accepts
.B \-\-fallback-style
for compatibility, but only file-based formatting rules are currently applied.
.SH OPTIONS
.TP
.BR \-i ", " \-\-in\-place
Rewrite the target file in place. A path argument is required.
.TP
.B \-\-style file
Use file-based configuration lookup. This is the supported style mode.
.TP
.B \-\-fallback-style \fISTYLE\fR
Accepted for compatibility with formatter-oriented tooling. The current
implementation ignores the fallback style value and still uses file-based
configuration.
.TP
.B \-\-root \fIDIR\fR
Limit
.I .mlang-format
config discovery to the given root directory.
.TP
.B \-\-assume\-filename \fIPATH\fR
Use
.I PATH
as the source path when searching for configuration.
.TP
.BR \-v ", " \-\-version
Print the formatter version and exit.
.TP
.BR \-h ", " \-\-help
Print a short usage line and exit.
.SH CONFIGURATION
The formatter reads
.I .mlang-format
files with keys including:
.TP
.B IndentWidth
Indent width in spaces.
.TP
.B ContinuationIndentWidth
Extra indent width in spaces for multiline argument and bracket continuation rows. Set to 0 to disable continuation indentation.
.TP
.B ConditionContinuationIndentWidth
Extra indent width in spaces for multiline if/while condition rows. The default 3 aligns rows after the control keyword.
.TP
.B IndentFunctionSignatureClosingParen
Whether a function signature closing parenthesis line containing an arrow, such as `) -> T {`, keeps continuation indentation.
.TP
.B EnsureTrailingNewline
Whether the formatter should ensure a final newline.
.TP
.B SpaceAfterComma
Whether a space is emitted after commas.
.TP
.B SpaceAfterColon
Whether a space is emitted after colons.
.TP
.B SpaceBeforeTernaryColon
Whether a space is emitted before the colon in ternary expressions.
.TP
.B SpaceAroundOperators
Whether arithmetic and assignment operators are surrounded by spaces.
.TP
.B SpaceAroundRelationalOperators
Whether relational operators are surrounded by spaces.
.TP
.B SpaceInsideBracesSingleLine
Whether single-line brace forms include interior spacing.
.TP
.B CompactFatArrow
Whether fat-arrow spacing is compacted in supported forms.
.SH EXAMPLES
.nf
mlang-format hello.mla
mlang-format -i hello.mla
cat hello.mla | mlang-format --assume-filename hello.mla
mlang-format --root . --style file src/main.mla
.fi
.SH SEE ALSO
.BR mlang (1),
.BR mlangd-mla (1)
```
